sources.entry: wshobson-agents - Plugins, agents, and skills for AI coding tools, including Python skills for testing, async, packaging, and uv.

summary.one_liner: A large collection of plugins, agents, skills, and commands for AI coding tools such as Claude Code, Codex CLI, Cursor, OpenCode, Copilot, and Pi, with a strong Python development focus.
summary.what_it_does: The repository provides 94 plugins (92 local, 2 external) containing 202 agent definitions, 185 skills, and 105 commands, all maintained from one Markdown source in the Claude Code plugin format. Adapters generate the formats needed by other harnesses, including OpenCode, Antigravity CLI, GitHub Copilot, and Pi, and map model aliases and tool permissions per harness. Plugins cover areas such as Python (testing, async, packaging, Django, FastAPI, uv), JavaScript/TypeScript, code review, debugging, Git, infrastructure, and security scanning. Individual skills can be installed with the gh skill command or the npx skills installer without the plugin's agents or commands. The README also describes a plugin-eval tool for static skill checks and experimental LLM-judge and Monte Carlo evaluation layers. An optional external Pensyve memory marketplace entry is mentioned.
use_cases: install Python development agents and skills into Claude Code
scaffold a FastAPI service with tests
add Python testing patterns to an AI coding assistant
set up Copilot or OpenCode agent profiles from one source
install a single skill without cloning the repo
run security scans and dependency checks with agent workflows
review code and manage Git workflows with AI agents
how_to_run: make install-opencode   # also: make install-antigravity, make install-copilot, make install-pi
notable: One Markdown source generates adapted components for seven AI coding harnesses
Large catalog: 94 plugins, 202 agents, 185 skills, 105 commands
Skills-only install path that reads directly from GitHub without cloning
Strong Python focus: testing, async, packaging, uv, Django, FastAPI
Includes plugin-eval static skill checks that need no model calls
caveats: Available components vary by installation route and by each harness's capabilities; Pi agents need a separate subagent extension
LLM judge and Monte Carlo evaluation layers are experimental, not validated against human labels, and may bill an Anthropic API account
Pensyve Cloud closed on October 1, 2026, so its hosted endpoints are unavailable; only the self-hosted runtime remains usable
keywords: share ai skills with my team
